schema.title: Response Get Me V1 Auth Me Get

get.description:
The parsed result of a source, in document order - read-only, for
verifying the pipeline actually produced the chunks it claims to
(``uploaded_sources.status`` and ``page_count``). Two-level ownership
check (rule 9): the project must belong to the caller, and the source
must belong to that project - either mismatch looks like a 404, never
a 403.

The project's claim verifications, newest first. ``topic_id`` narrows
the page to claims extracted for that one topic (Phase 6); omitted, every
verification is returned, manual and extracted alike.

post.description:
Turn the project's accepted topics into candidate claims and verify
each one (Phase 6). ``202`` with the queued ``extract_claims`` job;
progress and the result are on ``GET /v1/projects/{id}/jobs``. Refused
with ``409`` while one is already queued or running for this project;
otherwise always accepted - extraction is per-topic and additive, so a
repeat call after accepting more topics is the ordinary way to cover them
(``services.claim_extraction`` decides, topic by topic, what is already
covered; ``replace`` re-runs every accepted topic instead of only new
ones).

get.description:
A script with its segments and, per segment, the verified claims its
narration was allowed to draw on. Two-level ownership check (rule 9):
the project must belong to the caller and the script must belong to that
project - either mismatch is a 404, never a 403.

ProjectUpdateRequest.title: ProjectUpdateRequest
ProjectUpdateRequest.description:
All fields optional (PATCH semantics). Only keys actually present in
the request body reach the service - see ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)``
in the router - so omitting a field leaves it untouched, while
explicitly sending ``null`` for a nullable field (``description``)
clears it. ``title`` and the generation settings are ``NOT NULL`` in the
schema, so an explicit ``null`` for any of them is rejected here rather than
reaching the database.

RenderEnqueueRequest.title: RenderEnqueueRequest
RenderEnqueueRequest.description:
Which video to make. Both fields are required: the caller confirms the orientation and
quality they are asking for, rather than inheriting a default they may not have seen.

RenderProgressResponse.title: RenderProgressResponse
RenderProgressResponse.description:
Live progress of a render job. ``percent`` is real work done (chunks rendered, plus one
unit for assembly); ``eta_seconds`` is only present once enough chunks have finished to
estimate from.

RenderProgressStatusResponse.title: RenderProgressStatusResponse
RenderProgressStatusResponse.description:
The cheap poll: the latest render job and its progress, without re-evaluating the
storyboard.

RenderRetryRequest.title: RenderRetryRequest
RenderRetryRequest.description:
Carries no fields: a retry repeats the last failed render as it was asked for. Exists so
an unknown field in the body is rejected with 422 (rule 10).

SourceChunkListResponse.title: SourceChunkListResponse
SourceChunkListResponse.description:
Not paginated: a source's chunk count is bounded by ``MAX_PDF_PAGES``
(a few hundred at most), so the full, in-order list is returned at once.

StoryboardEnqueueRequest.title: StoryboardEnqueueRequest
StoryboardEnqueueRequest.description:
Carries no fields yet: generation takes its settings from
configuration, not the caller. Exists so an unknown field in the
request body is rejected with 422 (rule 10), the same pattern as
``SynthesisRequest``.

SynthesisRequest.title: SynthesisRequest
SynthesisRequest.description:
Carries no fields yet: synthesis takes its voice/settings from
configuration, not the caller. Exists so an unknown field in the request
body is rejected with 422 (rule 10) rather than silently ignored, the
same pattern as ``ScriptGenerateRequest``.

TopicEvidenceResponse.title: TopicEvidenceResponse
TopicEvidenceResponse.description: Where a topic was drawn from: one page-range of one uploaded source.

TopicExtractionRequest.title: TopicExtractionRequest
TopicExtractionRequest.description:
``replace`` - overwrite the topics a previous extraction derived (the
user's own are always kept). ``False`` refuses to run once there are any.

TopicKeywordsRequest.title: TopicKeywordsRequest
TopicKeywordsRequest.description: The user's own topics, in the order they should appear.

TopicListResponse.title: TopicListResponse
TopicListResponse.description:
Topics in reading order (depth-first, siblings by position). Not
paginated - see ``services.project_topics.list_topic_outline``.

TopicUpdateRequest.title: TopicUpdateRequest
TopicUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH semantics: only the keys present change. ``summary`` may be
``null`` to clear it; ``status`` and ``title`` are ``NOT NULL`` in the
schema, so an explicit ``null`` for either is rejected here.
